methods.name: SAR, spatial Durbin (SDM), SEM and SAC models by concentrated maximum likelihood; SAR and SDM impacts
methods.reference: spatialreg::lagsarlm(method = 'eigen', Durbin = FALSE/TRUE), errorsarlm, sacsarlm and impacts (lagImpactsExact, mixedImpactsExact), written out in base R (spatialreg not installed)
quantities: coefficients (SAR, SDM with lag.x, SEM, SAC)
SAR and SDM direct, indirect and total impacts
SEM coefficient SE, z and p
observed-information coefficient, rho and lambda SEs (SAR, SDM, SAC; lambda for the SEM)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 80: rho/lambda, coefficients and impacts Tol::iterative(1e-6) (golden section; flatness bound 1.3e-7 in rho), statistics and SEs 1e-5 relative; SAR residuals 1e-6 absolute (flatness bound x max |de/drho| 2.24); SAC by coordinate descent: Tol::iterative(1e-5) at tol 1e-10, 1e-4 at the default

deviations.quantity: SAR, SDM and SAC coefficient SEs, z and p; rho and lambda SE, z and p
deviations.note: p2a uses the observed information at the MLE (analytic for SAR, SDM and the SEM (lambda, s2) block; the SAC by central differences of the analytic gradient); spatialreg's method 'eigen' reports the expected information (sar_se), which differs at finite n; SEM beta SEs keep errorsarlm's block-diagonal form

methods.name: log|I - rho W| over the complex eigenvalues of W; feasible rho interval; traces of (I - rho W)^-1 and W (I - rho W)^-1
methods.reference: spatialreg method 'eigen': Re(sum(log(1 - rho * eigen(W)$values))), eig.range = 1 / range(Re(eig)); base::determinant cross-check
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 80: 1e-5 relative (statistics), rho interval 1e-6, count exact

methods.name: Spatial weight styles W, B, C, U, minmax and S; k-nearest-neighbour ties
methods.reference: spdep::nb2listw(style, zero.policy = TRUE) and spdep::knearneigh(x, k, use_kd_tree = FALSE), written out in base R (spdep not installed)
quantities: C, S and U sums with islands
neighbour sets on a tied integer grid
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 80: weights 1e-6, Moran's I 1e-5 relative; counts and neighbour ids exact
